description: 🚀 Team BLAST is a group of enthusiastic students passionate about space, science, and technology. We aim to use NASA's open data, AI, and programming to solve real-world challenges creatively. We welcome teammates skilled in Python, AI/ML, data analysis, web development, UI/UX, and space science. Beginners with curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to learn are welcome too! Join us to innovate, collaborate
